title: Bound authenticated-path SCHC scratch decoding by caller intent, not SCHC_MAX_DECOMPRESSED
description: Follow-up from project-LICHEN-worker6-d9ab (codec reconstruction caps removed). Remaining in-crate sites decode into [0u8; SCHC_MAX_DECOMPRESSED] (1500) scratch and thereby still cap reconstruction of valid profile-max SCHC packets: rust/lichen-schc/src/link.rs:219 (elided-address ingress scratch), link.rs:261 (create_fragment_sender validation), codec.rs parse_authenticated_dio_evidence (~line 1696) and authenticated_dio_destination_is_local (~line 2037). Fixing needs either a max-expansion-sized scratch (~22.6KB stack, unacceptable for STM32WL) or a redesign (header-only destination extraction from residue). Security-sensitive: decode-into-scratch exists so foreign packets cannot mutate caller output before rejection. Needs design judgment; not a minimal-diff change.
